title: gentiana verna subsp. tergestina
intro: Gentiana verna subsp. tergestina, commonly known as Trieste gentian, is a subspecies of the Gentiana verna plant, a type of flowering plant in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to stimulate digestion and alleviate symptoms of indigestion and nausea. The therapeutic actions of Trieste gentian are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides such as gentiopicroside and amarogentiogenin, that have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's iridoid glycosides have also been found to exhibit hepatoprotective and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential treatment for liver and immune-related disorders.
